pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:0.5: ime kho panayyāyo sattarasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.1: paṭhamasaṅghādisesaṃ tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako bhikkhunīsaṅghassa uddositaṃ datvā kālakato hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.4: eko assaddho appasanno eko saddho pasanno.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.6: athakho so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.8: evaṃ vutte so saddho pasanno taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.11: dutiyampi kho assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.13: athakho so saddho pasanno taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.16: tatiyampi kho so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.19: sace mayhaṃ bhavissati ahaṃpi bhikkhunīsaṅghassa dassāmīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.22: athakho so uddosito tehi bhājiyamāno tassa assaddhassa appasannassa pāpuṇi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.23: athakho so assaddho appasanno bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.25: evaṃ vutte thullanandā bhikkhunī taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.26: māyyo evaṃ avaca tumhākaṃ pitunā bhikkhunīsaṅghassa dinnoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.27: dinno na dinnoti vohārike mahāmatte pucchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.30: evaṃ vutte thullanandā bhikkhunī te mahāmatte etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.31: apinvayyā tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā sakkhiṃ ṭhapayitvā dānaṃ dīyamānanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.33: saccaṃ kho ayyā āhāti taṃ uddositaṃ bhikkhunīsaṅghassa akaṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.34: athakho so puriso parājito ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.36: kathaṃ hi nāma amhākaṃ uddositaṃ acchinnāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.39: athakho so puriso daṇḍito bhikkhunūpassayassa avidūre ājīvakaseyyaṃ kārāpetvā ājīvake uyyojesi
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.44: paṭhamaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo uddositaṃ acchindāpesuṃ dutiyampi daṇḍāpesuṃ tatiyampi bandhāpesuṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.46: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.47: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.48: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā usuyyavādikā viharissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.49: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.50: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī usuyyavādikā viharatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.53: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī usuyyavādikā viharissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.55: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.56.1: yā pana bhikkhunī usuyyavādikā vihareyya gahapatinā vā gahapatiputtena vā dāsena vā kammakarena vā antamaso samaṇaparibbājakenāpi ayaṃ bhikkhunī paṭhamāpattikaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.16: bhikkhuñca bhikkhuniñca sikkhamānañca sāmaṇerañca sāmaṇeriñca ṭhapetvā yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.17: aṭṭaṃ karissāmīti dutiyaṃ vā pariyesati gacchati vā āpatti dukkaṭassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.26: saṅgho va tassā āpattiyā mānattaṃ deti mūlāya paṭikassati abbheti na sambahulā bhikkhuniyo na ekā bhikkhunī tena vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.27: tasseva āpattinikāyassa nāma kammaṃ adhivacanaṃ tenapi vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
